title: 《伊利亚特》— 每日精读 READ 36a

questions.question: 阿伽门农夺走布里塞伊斯后，阿喀琉斯为什么暴怒到罢战？
options: 他早就想回家过平安长寿的日子，这次纠纷正好给了他退出的借口
他深爱布里塞伊斯，失去恋人的痛苦让他无心再为联军作战
他觊觎联军统帅之位，借这次冲突向阿伽门农的权威发起挑战
被当众夺走荣誉赏赐，等于宣布他不值那么多；在零和的荣誉体系里这是不能吞下的侮辱
questions.explanation: 在这个用战利品公开计价地位的世界里，geras 就是 timē 的实物；抢走它等于当众贬值。文章明确说他暴怒不是因为爱情。
questions.question_en: Why does Achilles rage and withdraw from battle after Agamemnon takes Briseis?
options_en: He had long wanted to go home to a safe, long life, and the quarrel gave him an excuse to quit
He deeply loves Briseis, and losing her leaves him with no heart to fight for the Greeks
He covets supreme command and uses the conflict to challenge Agamemnon's authority
Publicly stripping his prize of honor declared him worth less, an insult he can't swallow in a zero-sum honor system
questions.explanation_en: In a world that prices status publicly in spoils, the geras is timē made tangible, and taking it is a public devaluation. The article says outright that his fury is not about love.

questions.question: 第九卷里重礼请不动阿喀琉斯，后来让他重返战场、明知必死也要出战的是什么？
options: 阿伽门农又追加了更多黄金和赏赐，最终满足了他对自己荣誉份额的全部要求
宙斯直接降下神谕命令他出战，他不敢违抗神的意志
他算清了不朽之名比长寿更划算，冷静地做出了理性的选择
挚友帕特罗克洛斯之死带来的悲恸，愤怒由此从受伤的自尊转为丧友之痛
questions.explanation: 同一个人，黄金请不动，却为一个死去的朋友连命也不要了。让他出战的不是荣誉、重礼或战略，而是丧友之痛，这是愤怒的一次质变。
questions.question_en: Rich gifts in Book 9 fail to move Achilles. What finally brings him back to battle, knowing it means his death?
options_en: Agamemnon adds still more gold and gifts, finally meeting his demand for his share of honor
Zeus sends a direct command to fight, and he dares not defy the will of the gods
He calmly calculates that undying fame is worth more than a long life and makes the rational choice
Grief at the death of his friend Patroclus, which turns his rage from wounded pride into the pain of loss
questions.explanation_en: Gold could not move him, yet for a dead friend he gives up his life. What sends him back is not honor, gifts or strategy but grief, a qualitative change in his anger.

questions.question: 《伊利亚特》最终用什么收住阿喀琉斯的愤怒？
options: 希腊联军攻陷特洛伊、赢得战争，胜利终于补偿了他所受的屈辱
杀死赫克托耳、拖尸绕城之后，复仇已经完成，愤怒随之自然平息
普里阿摩斯跪求赎尸时，两人在「人都会死、都会失去所爱」上认出彼此，悲悯取代了怒火
诸神出面调停，命令他归还遗体，他只好服从并结束杀戮
questions.explanation: 拖尸辱骨时愤怒反而溢出了人的边界；真正让它熄灭的是普里阿摩斯的眼泪和共同的必死。全诗停在赫克托耳的葬礼，城破并不在诗中。
questions.question_en: What finally ends Achilles' rage in the Iliad?
options_en: The Greeks sack Troy and win the war, and victory at last makes up for his humiliation
Killing Hector and dragging his body around the walls completes the revenge, so the anger naturally subsides
When Priam kneels to ransom his son's body, the two recognize each other in shared mortality and loss, and pity replaces fury
The gods intervene and order him to return the body, and he obeys and stops the killing
questions.explanation_en: Desecrating Hector's body shows the rage overflowing human limits. What extinguishes it is Priam's tears and their shared mortality. The poem ends with Hector's funeral; the fall of Troy isn't in it.
